title: Denver AI DeckBootcamp — admin scratchpad
body:
Purpose: Pocket scratchpad for logistics, receipts, vendor contacts, and quick admin notes for the Denver AI DeckBootcamp (Sep 18–19 2025). Personal working doc — lots of shorthand. Use this to triage reimbursements and hand off last-minute ops to events ops.

Topline timeline (my flights/hotel):
- 2025-09-17 16:10 SFO → DEN UA 456 (checked bag). Arrive 20:05. Uber to hotel (The Maven at Dairy Block) — ~15–20min.
- 2025-09-18 08:00 ARRIVE VENUE for setup (Volunteer check-in at 08:30)
- 2025-09-18 09:30 Speaker sound check / AV run-through
- 2025-09-19 17:30 Tear down complete, head to airport for 20:35 flight UA 789 DEN → SFO

Packing quicklist (essentials):
- Laptop + power brick + USB-C hub
- HDMI adapter (venue uses VGA/HDMI switcher) — bring two
- Presenter remote + spare AAA batteries
- Business cards + sponsor contact list
- Swag: 40 t-shirts (L/XL), 200 stickers (small pack), 30 postcards
- Receipts wallet + phone charger

Expense & reimbursement notes (T&E quick rules):
- Per-diem: breakfast $20, lunch $25, dinner $55 (follow company policy — receipts required >$25)
- Ground: Uber/Taxi receipts acceptable. If ride >$120 need pre-approval by events lead.
- Hotel incidentals: pay on card, itemize on expense report; attach folio.
- Swag/caterer invoices: submit vendor invoice + proof of payment (card/ACH) and PO or pre-approval email.
- Expense naming convention: DEN-DECK-YYYYMMDD-<shortdesc> (e.g., DEN-DECK-20250918-caterer)
- Deadline: submit reimbursements within 30 days; events ops will escalate after 45 days.

Receipts capture tips (for me and volunteers):
- Photo all receipts immediately in Expensify app — timestamp + tag with attendee name
- For group meals, include attendee initials in memo line
- Save digital invoices for printing at hotel business center if needed

Vendor & venue quick contacts (first-call list):
- Venue: Mile High Conference Hall — Main Ops: Jordan Blake — +1 303-555-0142 — jordan.blake@mhconf.com — on-site contact desk (ext 0)
- AV: PeakSound AV — Lead tech: Maria Chen — +1 303-555-0199 — maria@peaksoundav.co — call if mics crackle or projector flicker
- Catering (coffee + lunch): CityCater Denver — coordinator: Luis Ortega — orders@citycaterdenver.com — Office +1 303-555-0321 — confirm vegetarian/gluten-free counts by Sep 15
- Furniture rental (highboy tables): Rocky Rentals — ops@rockyrentals.com — +1 303-555-0456 — delivery window 06:30–08:00 on 9/18
- Swag fulfillment (local pickup): PaperTrail Fulfillment — Samir Patel — +1 303-555-0580 — warehouse 07:00–10:00 pickup; need signature

On-site checklist (day-by-day):
- Day -1 (evening): Unpack swag, count shirts/stickers, label boxes by session
- Day 0 (morning setup): Meet venue ops at loading dock, confirm Wi-Fi SSID/password, test two projectors in main room, test stream setup
- Day 1 (live): Volunteer check-in table ready with name badges, badge printer ribbon spare, emergency snack box, first-aid kit
- Day 2 (wrap): Collect feedback cards, pack leftover swag (label 'returns'), confirm lost & found w/venue

Attendee / sponsor interactions (notes to self):
- Sponsor table B2 (LuxAnalytics) — contact: Priya Nair — priya@luxanalytics.ai — promise: demo slot 3:15–3:45 on Sep 18 — confirm A/V requirements (they asked for device HDMI passthrough)
- Hospitality dinner (invite-only): Sep 18 19:30 — 12 pax cap — confirm final headcount by 12:00 Sep 18; expense split: company covers up to $1,200 (pre-approve)

Unresolved questions / TODOs:
- Do we have a backup laptop with model demos? (ask infra — Marcus)
- Confirm whether venue Wi-Fi supports >200 concurrent devices on guest network — ACTION: ask Jordan (venue)
- Is there a dedicated phone/desk for lost badges? (volunteer rotation?)
- Confirm parking validation for staff — hotel front desk says validation code needed from events ops
- Got query from marketing: can we reorder 50 more stickers on-site? Estimate cost ~$30 + rush fee — ask Samir if same-day pickup possible

Quick policy snippets to copy into expense report (for approvers):
- Business meal policy: include attendee list + business purpose for any meal >$75
- Travel class: domestic flights <=5hrs economy (upgrade only with approvals)
- Swag procurement: single vendor purchases above $1,000 require procurement ticket and PO

Post-event handoff notes (to pass to events ops):
- Leftover shirts: 12 L, 8 XL — box labelled "returns: marketing" — pickup scheduled 2025-09-21 by PaperTrail
- AV invoice estimate: $1,120 (pending final hours) — will route to finance under project code TRAVEL-DECK-2025
- Lost & found: small electronics x2 (both turned into venue lost & found) — include owners names if claimed

Slack quick links & channels to ping:
- #events-denver (ops channel) — emergency pings only
- #events-logistics — for receipts & vendor invoice attachments
- Direct to Marcus Lee (@marcus) for infra/laptop emergency

Personal notes: keep receipts for Lyft/Uber under $10 too (some volunteers paying out of pocket). Don't forget to toggle phone to low-power mode during demos; test hotspot if venue wifi is flakey.

Final small checklist (day of travel):
- Boarding pass (digital + screenshot)
- Copies of hotel folio/confirmation
- Hard copy of speaker schedule + time blocks
- Spare mask and small hand sanitizer

Last-minute contact numbers (store in phone):
- Marcus Lee (events infra): +1 415-555-0167
- Jordan Blake (venue ops): +1 303-555-0142
- Maria Chen (AV lead): +1 303-555-0199
- PaperTrail pickup (Samir): +1 303-555-0580

Notes-to-self sign-off: pack receipts into envelope labeled DEN-DECK-RECEIPTS-20250919 and upload Expensify photos nightly. If anything gets delayed >48h, escalate to events-ops@redwood.ai.
